entry_state: The language now carries exact contextual values,portable record identity,declared compilation scope and restricted posting rules. exit_state: The language distinguishes conjunctive evidence,revision and posterior reweighting;packages and migrations preserve explicit semantics. Typed errors retain missing facts,infeasibility,rule conflict and numerical failure as different results. findings: Rejected branches retain their evidence history,and reweighting remains a separate likelihood operation. Package load order cannot override a mandatory accounting rule.

The diagnostic table maps distinct failures to specific recovery paths;unknown required inputs never become zero. No confirmed new defect in the completed chapter.
